bullets.text: Cyclone Murasu has triggered an orange alert for Chennai and Tiruvallur with heavy rain expected, and the office should monitor school holiday announcements.
Three people were arrested after a knife-point robbery targeting a couple at Besant Nagar beach in Chennai, and the office should watch local safety updates.
A two-wheeler parked near the Avadi bus stand caught fire from Deepavali firecracker sparks, and the district team should monitor fire safety incidents.
Union Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw launched the Semicon 2.0 Portal and announced 12 new approvals, and the portfolio team should track electronics manufacturing updates.
Technology distributors Redington and Ingram Micro are benefiting from India's AI boom by supplying hardware, and the portfolio team should monitor market trends.
A new book titled Artificial Intelligence and Maritime Law authored by V.J. Mathew was released, and the office should note this legal development.

stories.title: Cyclone Murasu: Orange Alert for Chennai and Tiruvallur; Heavy Rain Expected – Will Schools Declare Holiday?
takeaways: An orange alert for heavy rain was issued for Chennai and Thiruvallur due to monsoonal cyclones.
District administrations are reviewing preparedness and considering school holiday declarations.
